plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: DataCraft PM, the hands-on way of working: outcome-sized tickets, one session per outcome by default, sibling sessions for independent tickets, opt-in orchestration with up to six subagents, proportionate verification, delivery acceptance and concise handoffs. Unattended ticket runs live in the factory plugin; the credential guard moved to sdlc (0.24.0). Existing project requirements and permissions remain binding.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: DataCraft software factory: Runway, a deterministic loop that runs ready Linear tickets unattended in git worktrees, preps decision packets for the tickets that need Joe, and finishes with a whole-branch review and a PR body. The runway skill covers kickoff, the gating rule for ready-for-agent vs ready-for-human, worker-env.md, the conflict screen, scheduling and retro. Install with sdlc and Matt Pocock's skills.

plugins.name: design-dc
plugins.description: DataCraft design workflow: design-handoff (the crossing brief for claude.ai/design), html-artifacts (rich editorial HTML instead of long markdown), excalidraw-artifacts (HTML artifact → locked Excalidraw markup canvas, and annotation readback), design-sync (component-library sync via the built-in DesignSync tool). Pairs with the separate claude-design bridge plugin.

plugins.name: fm-dc
plugins.description: Agentic FileMaker development: SaXML patching with verify/rollback, DDR analysis, snippet validation, server-connection doctrine, and project scaffolding. Commands /fm-dc:fm-init, fm-scaffold, fm-status, fm-rollback, fm-docs-sync.

plugins.name: fm-lens
plugins.description: FM Lens (source of truth: the private FM_Agent_Lens repo, lens/): agentic FileMaker development on machines with the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit (ADT). Ships the FM Lens FileMaker plug-in, an agent's eyes and hands inside FileMaker Pro: window and web viewer snapshots, state probes, menus, go-to-layout, dialog handling, the XML clipboard and a drop-folder command channel. Its skills fill what Claris's ADT plugin leaves out: native layout rendering traps, the per-build capability list, the master quirks list, connection lifecycle and unwedge playbook, and filemaker (fm) CLI field notes. Install alongside Claris's filemaker-agentic-development plugin, INSTEAD of fm-dc.

plugins.name: agenticdev-filemaker-standards
plugins.description: The agenticdev Claris ADT standards pack (naming, patterns, advisory; prose only, as ADT 0.9 reads no checks file) — the house FileMaker conventions fm-lens points at. Install, then run `adt standards use agenticdev` in the project. Source of truth is standards/pack in the private FM_Agent_Lens repo; this entry only points at it.

plugins.name: ui-test
plugins.description: Agent-run UI tests for any macOS app with a window (native Swift apps, FileMaker Pro, Electron): ui-test splits assertions by evidence channel, writes a typed runner instruction, dispatches a Codex computer-use worker under Ringer, validates the returned receipt (screenshots + on-screen reads) with executed checks, and hands a fresh verifier task the verdict. PASS-OBSERVED / FAIL / BLOCKED outcomes; per-app target profiles; ships the tool matrix observed on this stack.

plugins.name: basecamp-dc
plugins.description: Basecamp client-face layer, opt-in per repo via .basecamp/config.json (inert without it; pm never depends on it). bc-client-face carries the conventions — client's side (New requests, Questions for you) and Joe's side (Shipped / Active / Backlog as the status), Work items as clusters with Ref footers, [bc:<id>] tokens in TASKS.md, plain-English voice, quirk safety rules; bc-close-out ships a task (move to Shipped unchecked, comment, prepend to What shipped without duplicating images); a session-start hook surfaces the project when the config is present. Rides on the official basecamp CLI and its /basecamp skill for mechanics.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: The credential guard (a PreToolUse hook that blocks staging or committing credential-shaped files, active wherever sdlc is installed; moved from pm in 0.2.0) plus repo-level enforcement kits, Claude Code only, no pm or Ringer dependency. gate-hooks installs one gate script into a repo's .claude/ — production gate, protected paths, a test lock for fix tasks, a commit and Stop backstop — driven by .claude/sdlc/gates.json. review-policy sets up REVIEW.md and runs a read-only, fresh-context policy reviewer against it. Its Codex edition carries the credential guard only.
